P.name: Essence Theft
P.title: Template:Data Ahri/Essence Theft
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Essence Theft|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Ahri
|skill        = I
|icon         = Essence Theft.png
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Ahri''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Essence Fragment'' whenever she kills a {{tip|minion}} or {{tip|monster}}. At 9 stacks, she consumes them to {{tip|heal}} herself for {{pplevel|35 to 95|color=heal}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}.
|description2 = Additionally, whenever '''Ahri''' scores a champion {{tip|takedown}} within 3 seconds of damaging them, she consumes their essence to heal herself for {{pplevel|75 to 165|color=heal}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}.
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Self
|notes        = 
* No additional details.
<!-- Blurb -->
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Ahri}} generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Essence Fragment'' from killing {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}. At max stacks, she consumes them to {{as|{{sti|heal}}}} herself.
|blurb2       = Whenever '''Ahri''' scores a champion {{tip|takedown}} within a short time of damaging them, she consumes their essence to {{as|{{sti|heal}}}} herself.
}}

R.name: Spirit Rush
R.title: Template:Data Ahri/Spirit Rush
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Spirit Rush|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Ahri |skill = R |icon = Spirit Rush.png |description = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ahri''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target location and then fires essence bolts to up to 3 nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemies, each dealing {{as|magic damage}}.

''Spirit Rush'' can be recast twice more within 15 seconds of the activation at no additional cost, with a 1-second {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} between casts. Consuming a champion's essence with ''{{ai|Essence Theft|Ahri}}'' while ''Spirit Rush'' is active extends the recast duration by and up to 10 seconds, and grants an additional recast, storing up to 3 recasts at a time. |description2 = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Ahri''' mimics the first cast's effects. |leveling = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|75 to 175}} {{as|(+ 35% AP)}}}} |description3 = ''Spirit Rush's recast duration will persist even after using all recasts. {{ai|Fox-Fire|Ahri}} can be cast during the dash.'' |target range = {{tt|500|Maximum dash distance}} |cast time = none |effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|600|Energy bolts target search radius, from Ahri's location on dash end/interrupt}} |speed = {{dv|{{tt|1200 + {{as|100% movement speed|movement speed}}|Dash speed}}|{{tt|1400|Energy bolt missile speed}}}} |cooldown = {{tt|{{ap|140 to 100}}|Starts after first cast, and refreshes upon gaining recasts}} |cdstart = on-cast |cost = 100 |costtype = mana |targeting = Location |affects = Enemies |damagetype = Magic |spellshield = True |spelleffects = aoe |projectile = True |grounded = True |knockdown = True |outofrange = cast at max |notes = {{always quickcast}} * Each cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive. * There's a slight delay before a champion gains vision of the fog of war once inside it. Because of this, if '''Ahri''' dashes into it, it is possible that ''Spirit Rush'' will not target any enemy in range. * The bolts do not fire if '''Ahri''' dies while {{tip|dash|dashing}}, unless she was saved by {{tip|resurrection}}. ** The bolts will fire if the dash is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} by other means. * This ability's damage is calculated based on the caster's current stats and changes dynamically. |blurb = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Ahri}} {{tip|dash|dashes}} forward and fires essence bolts to nearby enemies, dealing {{as|magic damage}}. |blurb2 = '''Ahri''' can cast this ability up to three times in quick succession. During this time, additional casts are gained whenever a {{tip|champion|champion's}} essence is consumed via ''{{ai|Essence Theft|Ahri|Essence Theft}}''. }}
